dz: 阿巴西德革命:阿布·穆斯林·霍拉萨尼手下的哈西米叛军占领了乌迈亚德省的首府默夫,标志着阿巴西德起义的巩固.
de: Abbasid Revolution: The Hashimi rebels under Abu Muslim Khorasani take Merv, capital of the Umayyad province Khorasan, marking the consolidation of the Abbasid revolt.
